name: Spinach Lettuce Salad
description: A fresh and versatile green salad with a homemade balsamic dressing and a crunchy topping made from toasted almonds, sesame seeds, and noodle soup mix.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg noodle soup mix (without seasoning packet)
Any type of green leafy vegetable (spinach, lettuce, broccoli, coleslaw)

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the dressing ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to use.
Melt butter in a pan and add almonds, noodle soup mix (without spice packet), and sesame seeds. Toast until lightly browned.
Prepare the salad greens and store in the refrigerator.
Just before serving, pour the dressing over the salad and top with the toasted almond mixture.

keywords: spinach salad, lettuce salad, homemade dressing, crunchy topping

_similar.name: Mandarin Orange Salad
_similar.description: A classic spinach and lettuce salad with mandarin oranges and toasted almonds, dressed with a sweet and tangy homemade vinaigrette.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean the romaine lettuce, red tip lettuce, and spinach. Dry thoroughly and rip into bite-sized pieces.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, mustard, and salt. Bring to a boil, then allow to cool.
Once cooled, blend the dressing mixture in a blender until smooth.

_similar.name: Wilting Spinach Salad
_similar.description: A warm spinach salad with garlic, almonds, and a balsamic vinegar dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and tear spinach. Dry and pat with a tea towel.
In a small skillet, heat olive oil and crush garlic into it.
Add almonds and stir until lightly browned.
Add balsamic vinegar and turn off heat.
Immediately pour the hot dressing over the spinach salad and toss.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: spinach salad, wilting spinach, warm salad

_similar.name: Greek Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing Greek salad with marinated tomatoes, mixed greens, feta cheese, and a homemade dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: To Marinate Tomatoes: Cut tomatoes in halves or quarters. Squeeze out seeds and juice and cut into bite-size pieces. Whisk marinade together, stir in tomatoes, and let stand for at least 1 hour.

To Make Dressing: Place garlic, vinegar, and seasonings in a blender and whirl to blend. While still whirling, gradually drizzle in the oil. Add anchovies. Can be used immediately or covered and refrigerated.
To Complete Salad: Mix greens, onions, olives, pepper, and cheese. Add marinated tomatoes. Toss and drizzle dressing over salad. Add croutons if desired.

_similar.keywords: Greek salad, marinated tomatoes, feta cheese, homemade dressing

_similar.name: Romaine Salad with Orange
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring romaine lettuce, oranges, and red onion with a light vinaigrette dressing.
recipeIngredient: ¼ cup red wine vinegar or cider vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, drained mandarin oranges, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a separate bowl, combine the red wine vinegar, oil, minced parsley, garlic, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: romaine salad, orange salad, vinaigrette dressing
